meta.name: scope-guardian
meta.description: Protect project scope at every level — feature, sprint, and project. Use when evaluating new ideas, reviewing the backlog, assessing project size, or when the game's vision has grown beyond what one person can build. The external "no" that ADHD needs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 守住项目边界,避免功能越做越多
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你总想往项目里加新点子,需要有人帮你踩刹车。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your project scope in check and stop feature creep.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you always want to add new ideas and need someone to say no.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用「核心测试」判断新功能能否砍掉,并给功能分「核心/重要/锦上添花/不做」四档;每加一项就要求砍掉一项或延后日期,还会帮你估算内容成本。
howto.when: 当你评估新想法、审查待办事项,或发现项目范围超出可控时,它会介入审查。

say.text: 我想加个钓鱼系统,它算核心还是附加?
say.note: Claude 会运行核心测试并分配范围等级。

say.text: 现在待办太多,帮我按范围等级排个优先级。
say.note: Claude 会审查清单,标出可砍项。

say.text: 12月要发布,这个功能加得进去吗?需要砍什么?
say.note: Claude 会核对发布日期与内容预算,给出取舍。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the Core Test to judge if a new feature can be cut, assigns a level (Core/Important/Nice-to-have/Out-of-scope), demands something be removed for each addition, and helps estimate content cost.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you evaluate new ideas, review the backlog, or find the project scope growing beyond what one person can build.

say_en.text: I want to add a fishing system. Is it core or extra?
say_en.note: Claude applies the Core Test and assigns a scope level.

say_en.text: The backlog is huge. Help me prioritize by scope level.
say_en.note: Claude reviews the list and flags what can be cut.

say_en.text: Launching in December. Can this feature fit? What gets cut?
say_en.note: Claude checks the ship date and content budget, then suggests trade-offs.
